claims.claim: UK used Lens are available in our shop
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens; no evidence of origin (UK) or shop availability.

risks.risk: Lens may be incomplete (missing one or more caps/hood/other small accessories).
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the full set laid out (front cap, rear cap, any hood/filter) and/or a video of the lens with all included parts visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lens only (no guarantee of caps/hood/filters).

risks.risk: Optics condition may be poor (scratches, haze, fungus, oil on blades/contacts).
risks.proof: Macro close-ups of the front and rear glass under light from angles (including visible reflections) plus a quick test shot showing contrast/flare.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not-fully-tested optics (worst-case: possible haze/fungus/scratches).

risks.risk: Autofocus/zoom may not work smoothly (or at all).
risks.proof: A short video demonstrating zoom ring movement and autofocus attempt on a compatible camera body (showing focus change).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested for AF/zoom functionality.

risks.risk: Aperture/iris may be stuck or slow (affects exposure and image quality).
risks.proof: Close-up video of the aperture blades while switching aperture (or a camera test showing consistent exposure across apertures).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case aperture not confirmed.

risks.risk: Mount compatibility may be wrong for the buyer’s camera (EFS is Canon APS-C; exact fit matters).
risks.proof: Photo of the rear mount clearly showing the exact Canon mount type, plus confirmation of compatibility with the buyer’s camera model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming compatibility is uncertain beyond the visible EFS marking.

risks.risk: Serial number/warranty/proof of purchase may be missing (affects legitimacy and resale).
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number engraving and any receipt/warranty card (if available).

proof_requests: Send clear photos confirming all included accessories (front cap, rear cap, hood, filters if any) laid out together.
Provide macro close-ups of both front and rear glass showing any scratches/haze/fungus under strong angled light.
Share a short video showing zoom ring movement and autofocus attempt on a working Canon body (focus change visible).
Show aperture/iris condition via a close-up video or a camera test across apertures.
Send a sharp photo of the rear mount area showing the exact mount fit; confirm which Canon camera models it works on.
Provide a photo of the lens serial number and any receipt/warranty details.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. Seller’s “UK used” statement is not supported by the report, so pricing should assume unverified origin and untested condition.
